goal: VC-201-072 (P0) claims mastery of: Bind credentials to workspace, mission, capabilities, audience, and expiry; an agent cannot reuse a token for a different mission or broader tool scope and cancellation revokes eligible credentials.. Its own narrative does not claim delivery: PARTIAL: gateway workload credentials are issued, authorized and revoked, with token and spend budgets enforced. Verified by `crates/susi-server/src/gateway_keys.rs`: issue_authorize_and_revoke, enforces_token_budget, enforces_spend_budget. Residual: binding to workspace, mission, capabilities, audience and expiry, and revocation on cancellation, are not individually enumerated by a named check. E. Prove or refute it: add a nonzero test named vc_201_072_mastery_* that exercises the capability on its production path, and record exactly which part is missing when it cannot be proven. Coverage is not mastery: this closes only when the capability is verified, and a linked closed task is not evidence. Closing this task records the outcome, not a passing test: write .agents/roadmap-verdicts/<the vector>.json with verdict 'delivered' (and the test or record that proves it) or 'not-delivered' (with what is missing and the task ids that track the follow-up work), then run scripts/check-roadmap-verdict.py <the vector> — which is this task's acceptance. A refutation therefore closes the task and files the work, instead of stalling on a test that cannot pass; the roadmap and the queue both understand the record.
title: Verify mastery: Issue scoped expiring workload credentials
